Here is the full context: ## User Requirements 1. **Authoring**: Both pre-authored (from course markdown using fenced code blocks) and dynamic live creation through a UI 2. **Delivery**: Both live/synchronous (lecturer pushes questions, students answer together) and async self-paced 3. **Question types**: Multiple choice + true/false 4. **Lecturer role**: Identified via a `lecturers` property in course properties (comma-separated GitHub logins) 5. **Analytics**: Real-time feedback to lecturer — time to answer, correct answers, incorrect answers ## Codebase Architecture ### Tech Stack - SvelteKit with Svelte 5 runes (custom `rune()` wrapper from `$lib/runes.svelte.ts`) - Skeleton UI v4 + Tailwind CSS v4 - Supabase (REST-only, no realtime subscriptions) for persistence - PartyKit WebSockets (external server at tutors.partykit.dev, simple broadcast relay) for real-time - Auth.js with GitHub OAuth - Iconify for icons - Course content loaded from CDN as pre-generated JSON ### Key Patterns **Route pattern** (e.g., `src/routes/(course-reader)/time/[courseid]/+page.ts`): ```ts export const ssr = false; export const load = async ({ params, fetch }) => { const course = await courseService.readCourse(params.courseid, fetch); currentCourse.value = course; return { course, lo: course }; }; ``` **Supabase client**: Created at `src/lib/services/community/utils/supabase-client.ts` using PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY env vars. All operations use `supabase.from("table").upsert()/.select()/.update()`. Guarded by `PUBLIC_ANON_MODE !== "TRUE"`. **PartyKit WebSocket**: Uses `partysocket` npm package. Pattern: ```ts import PartySocket from "partysocket"; const partyKitServer = PUBLIC_party_kit_main_room; // env var // Connect to a room const socket = new PartySocket({ host: partyKitServer, room: "room-name" }); socket.send(JSON.stringify(payload)); socket.addEventListener("message", (event) => { const data = JSON.parse(event.data); }); ``` Room naming: course rooms use `courseId` as room name. PartyKit server is a simple broadcast relay — all messages sent to a room are broadcast to all other clients in that room. **Reactive state**: `rune(initialValue)` creates a getter/setter wrapper around `$state()`: ```ts export const rune = (initialValue: T) => { let _rune = $state(initialValue); return { get value() { return _rune; }, set value(v: T) { _rune = v; } }; }; ``` **Course properties**: `Properties` is `{ [key: string]: string }` — a dynamic dict. Accessed as `course.properties.someKey`. No need to modify external packages. A `lecturers` property would be a comma-separated string: `"user1,user2"`. **Markdown custom fenced blocks**: The mermaid pattern in `src/lib/services/markdown/services/markdown.svelte.ts`: ```ts const defaultFence = markdownIt.renderer.rules.fence!; markdownIt.renderer.rules.fence = (tokens, idx, options, env, self) => { const token = tokens[idx]; if (token.info.trim() === "mermaid") { return `
${escaped}
`; } return defaultFence(tokens, idx, options, env, self); }; ``` **Navigator buttons**: `src/lib/ui/navigators/buttons/SearchButton.svelte` pattern — component with Icon, click handler that uses `goto()`, placed in `MainNavigator.svelte`'s `` section. **Layout wrapping**: Course reader pages live under `src/routes/(course-reader)/` which has a shared layout calling `tutorsConnectService.learningEvent()` on navigation. **User identity**: `tutorsId` global rune of type `TutorsId = { name, login, email, image, share, sentiment }`. `tutorsId.value?.login` is the GitHub username. ### Existing File Locations - Services: `src/lib/services/` (course/, community/, connect/, markdown/, themes/) - UI components: `src/lib/ui/` (learning-objects/, navigators/, components/) - Routes: `src/routes/(course-reader)/` - Supabase client: `src/lib/services/community/utils/supabase-client.ts` - Presence service: `src/lib/services/community/services/presence.svelte.ts` - Runes: `src/lib/runes.svelte.ts` - MainNavigator: `src/lib/ui/navigators/MainNavigator.svelte` ## Design Decisions ### Quiz Data Flow **Pre-authored quizzes from markdown**: 1. Lecturer writes `\`\`\`quiz ... \`\`\`` fenced code block in course note/lab content 2. When rendered, the markdown pipeline extracts it and emits a special HTML div (like mermaid) 3. A Svelte action or component picks up the div and renders a "Create Quiz" button for lecturers or quiz link for students 4. On first "activation", the quiz definition is stored to Supabase **Dynamic quizzes**: 1. Lecturer navigates to quiz dashboard for the course 2. Creates quiz through a form UI 3. Quiz stored directly to Supabase **Live quiz session**: 1. Lecturer starts a session → creates entry in Supabase, opens PartyKit room `quiz-{courseId}-{sessionId}` 2. Students see "Live Quiz Active" indicator and join 3. Lecturer pushes questions one at a time via PartyKit (WITHOUT correct answer) 4. Students pick answers → stored in Supabase + lightweight PartyKit broadcast (just "answered" event) 5. Lecturer sees real-time participation count; can query Supabase for aggregated results 6. Lecturer reveals results → broadcasts correct answer + distribution via PartyKit 7. All students see results 8. Repeat for each question, then end session **Async quiz**: 1. Student opens a published quiz from the quiz dashboard 2. Questions displayed one at a time or all at once (without correct answers visible) 3. Student submits → stored in Supabase 4. After submission, results are shown (which answers were correct) ### Supabase Tables 1. `tutors_quizzes` — Quiz definitions - id (uuid, PK) - course_id (text, NOT NULL) - title (text, NOT NULL) - questions (jsonb, NOT NULL) — Array of {id, type, text, options, correctIndex} - created_by (text, NOT NULL) — GitHub login - source (text, NOT NULL) — 'course' | 'dynamic' - time_limit (integer, nullable) — default seconds per question - status (text, NOT NULL, default 'draft') — 'draft' | 'published' | 'archived' - created_at (timestamptz, default now()) 2. `tutors_quiz_sessions` — Live sessions - id (uuid, PK) - quiz_id (uuid, FK → tutors_quizzes.id) - course_id (text, NOT NULL) - lecturer_id (text, NOT NULL) - status (text, NOT NULL) — 'waiting' | 'active' | 'reviewing' | 'completed' - current_question (integer, default 0) - started_at (timestamptz, default now()) - ended_at (timestamptz, nullable) 3. `tutors_quiz_responses` — Individual answers - id (uuid, PK) - quiz_id (uuid, FK) - session_id (uuid, FK, nullable) — null for async attempts - question_id (text, NOT NULL) - student_id (text, NOT NULL) — GitHub login - selected_index (integer, NOT NULL) - is_correct (boolean, NOT NULL) - response_time_ms (integer, NOT NULL) - submitted_at (timestamptz, default now()) ### PartyKit Messages (Live Mode) Room: `quiz-{courseId}-{sessionId}` Message types: - `{type: "quiz:join", studentId, studentName, avatar}` — Student joins - `{type: "quiz:question", questionIndex, text, options, questionType, timeLimit}` — Lecturer pushes question (NO correctIndex) - `{type: "quiz:answer", studentId, questionIndex, selectedIndex, responseTimeMs}` — Student answers (broadcast to all — lecturer aggregates, other students just see "someone answered") - `{type: "quiz:reveal", questionIndex, correctIndex, distribution}` — Lecturer reveals results - `{type: "quiz:end"}` — Lecturer ends session - `{type: "quiz:participant-count", count}` — Updated participant count ### File Structure to Create ``` src/lib/services/quiz/ index.ts — Re-exports types.ts — Quiz TypeScript interfaces services/ quiz.svelte.ts — Quiz CRUD service (Supabase operations) quiz-session.svelte.ts — Live session management (PartyKit + state) src/lib/ui/quiz/ QuizDashboard.svelte — List quizzes, start sessions QuizCreator.svelte — Create/edit quiz form QuizQuestion.svelte — Render a single question (shared by live + async) QuizLiveHost.svelte — Lecturer's live session control panel QuizLiveStudent.svelte — Student's live session answer view QuizAsync.svelte — Self-paced quiz taking QuizResults.svelte — Results summary (per-question breakdown) QuizResultsChart.svelte — Bar chart for answer distribution src/lib/ui/navigators/buttons/ QuizButton.svelte — Nav bar quiz button src/routes/(course-reader)/quiz/[courseid]/ +page.ts — Route loader +page.svelte — Quiz dashboard page create/ +page.ts +page.svelte — Quiz creation page [quizid]/ +page.ts +page.svelte — Async quiz taking / quiz detail results/ +page.ts +page.svelte — Quiz results page live/[sessionid]/ +page.ts +page.svelte — Live session page (host or student view) ``` ### Lecturer Detection Helper function: ```ts function isLecturer(course: Course, login: string): boolean { const lecturers = course.properties?.lecturers; if (!lecturers) return false; return lecturers.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).includes(login); } ``` Please design a complete, ordered, step-by-step implementation plan covering: 1. Supabase table creation SQL 2. TypeScript types and interfaces 3. Quiz service (CRUD operations) 4. Live session service (PartyKit integration) 5. Route and page creation 6. UI components 7.
